Vei e dingyin hmo a vang lae hah suipahla kahni touh vei e dawkvah na kan han.
Hahoi suilaikaw kahni touh na sak han. Hot teh Ephod kahni touh a pawi koe vaihma angki e a thung lah na mawp han.
Suilaikaw kahni touh alouklah na sak vaiteh, hot teh a hma lae vaihma angki kannae rahim lae kâpatawpnae koe kahawicalah kawng e, vaihma angki kannae van lah na mawp han.

Hahoi vaihma angki laikaw dawkvah, Ephod dawk e laikaw hah kamthim pahla hoi mekkhuisin han. Kahawicalah kawng e vaihma angki suinae teh avanlah ao thai nahane hoi Ephod hah vaihma angki hoi a kâphoi thai hoeh nahan,
hottelah Aron teh, hmuen kathoung koe a cei toteh, BAWIPA hmalah pou a kamnue nahanelah, a lungthin dawk lawkcengnae ephod dawkvah, Isarel catounnaw e min lah ao han.

Urim hoi thummim hah lawkcengnae Ephod dawk na hruek vaiteh, BAWIPA hmalah a cei toteh, Aron e lungthin dawk ao han. Hottelah Aron ni BAWIPA hmalah Isarel catounnaw lawkcengnae hah a lung dawk pou ao han.   
\s1 Angkidung
Hahoi vaihma angkidung hah kamthim pahla hoi dueng na kawng awh han.
A lungui vah lû mahrawk nahanelah na paaw pouh han. Ka aw e a vak hoeh nahanelah, angki lahuen patetlah arai na yep han.
Kamthim, dikpaling, loukloukkaang e hoi sak e talepawnaw hai angki petkâkalup lah na sak han. Hote rahak dawkvah, suidinghling hoi petkâkalup lah na sak han.
Hottelah angkidung dawkvah, suidinghling buet touh hoi talepaw, suidinghling hoi talepaw petkâkalup lah arai dawk na sak han.

Aron ni thaw a tawk navah, hottelah a kamthoup han. Hottelah BAWIPA e hmalah hmuen kathoung dawk kâen tâconae tueng nah a pawlawk thai laipalah a due hoeh nahanelah na sak pouh han.   
\s1 Lupawk
Hahoi suikathoung phen na sak vaiteh, avan vah kutnoutthutnae ca tarik e patetlah BAWIPA KOE THOUNGNAE telah na thut han.
Hot teh lupawk dawk ao nahanelah, lupawk e hmalah kamthim pahla rui hoi na bet han.

Hot teh, Aron tampa dawk ao han. Isarel catounnaw ni kathounge a poehnonaw pueng a thoungsaknae, payonpakainae kaawm e hah Aron ni koung a phu han. Hot teh BAWIPA hmalah dâw han kamcu e lah ao thai nahanelah, a tampa dawk pou a ta han.   
\s1 Vaihma hnicu
Angkidung teh loukloukkaang e hoi kahawicalah na carouk vaiteh na kawng han. Loukloukkaang e hni hoiyah vaihma lupawk hah na sak vaiteh, taisawm hai na sak pouh han.
Aron capanaw hanlah, angkidung hah na sak pouh vaiteh, taisawm hai ahnimouh han na sak pouh han. A bawilen sak nahan hoi kahawisakkung lah a bawilakhung na sak pouh han.
Na hmau Aron hoi a capanaw hah na pathoup han, kai han vaihma thaw a tawk thai nahan satui na awi vaiteh, na hmoun vaiteh, na thoung sak han.
Hahoi caici lah a onae na ramuk nahanelah, loukloukkaang e hnadung na sak pouh vaiteh, a keng koehoi a phai totouh a pha han.

Hot teh Aron hoi a capanaw kamkhuengnae lukkareiim koe kâennae tueng dawk thoseh, hmuen kathoung koe thaw tawk nahanlah bawknae khoungroe teng a cei nah thoseh a kamthoup awh han. Nahoeh pawiteh, yonpen e lah awm vaiteh, dout awh langvaih. Hot teh amamouh hoi ka tho hane catounnaw totouh a yungyoe hanlah caksak e phunglam doeh toe.
Kai hanlah vaihma thaw tawk thai nahan kamthoung sak hanelah, ahnimae lathueng na sak hane teh, hetheh doeh. Maitotan kanaw e buet touh, tutan kanaw e kahni touh toun han kaawm hoeh e,
tonphuenhoehe hoi, tonphuenhoehe satui hoi sak e vaiyei phen, satui hoi sak e kanem e vaiyei tonphuenhoehe naw hah na la han, kanui e tavai hoi na sak han.
Hotehah tangthung dawk na ta vaiteh, maitotan hoi tutan kahni touh hoi tangthung hah na thokhai han.
Aron hoi a canaw hah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koevah na thokhai vaiteh, tui na pâsu han.
Khohnanaw na la vaiteh, angki, hni, ephod hah Aron na kho sak vaiteh, ka talue e angkidung hah taisawm hoi kâyeng sak han.
A lû dawk vaihmanaw e lupawk na kâmuk sak vaiteh, hote lupawk van vah kathoungnae lakhung na kâmuk sak han.
Hahoi awi hane satui na la vaiteh, a lû dawk na awi pouh vaiteh na hluk pouh han.
Hahoi, a capanaw na kaw vaiteh, na kho sak han.
Aron hoi a capanaw hah taisawm na kâyeng sak vaiteh, bawilakhung hai na kâmuk sak vaiteh, vaihma coungnae hah a yungyoe hanlah na caksak han. Hottelahoi Aron hoi capanaw teh na thoung sak han.
Hahoi, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hmalah maitotan na thokhai vaiteh, Aron hoi a capanaw ni maito e lû dawk kut a toung awh han.
Hottelah, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim tho teng vah, BAWIPA hmalah maitotan hah na thei han
Maitotan e thi hah na la vaiteh khoungroe ki dawk na kutdawn hoi na nep han. Hahoi kacawie thi hah khoungroe kung koe koung na rabawk han.
A thung e a kosanaw hoi a thin dawk kaawm e a hmue, a kuen kahni touh hoi athawnaw na la vaiteh, khoungroe dawk hmai na sawi han.
Maitotan e a tak, a pho, a khoknaw teh rapan alawilah hmai na sawi han. Hot hah teh yon thuengnae doeh.
Tutan buet touh na thokhai vaiteh, Aron hoi a capanaw ni a lû dawk kut a toung awh han.
Tutan na thei vaiteh, a thi teh khougroe tengpam vah abuemlahoi na kathek han.
A moi hah na tâtueng vaiteh, a ruenthin hoi a khok hoi a lûnaw hah na hruek han.
Hahoi tutan e tak abuemlahoi khoungroe dawk hmai na sawi han. Hothateh, BAWIPA hanlah hmaisawi thuengnae, BAWIPA koe hmai hoi hmuitui hmaisawi thuengnae doeh.
Hahoi tutan buet touh bout na thokhai han. Aron hoi a capanaw ni tutan e lû dawk a kut a toung awh han.

Tutan hah na thei vaiteh, a thi hah na la vaiteh, Aron e aranglae hnârakong koe, a capanaw e aranglae hnârakong koe, aranglae kutpui hoi a capanaw e aranglae khokpuinaw dawk na nep pouh vaiteh, khoungroe lathueng lah a thi hah na kathek han.

Hahoi khoungroe dawk e thi hoi hluk e satui hah na la vaiteh, Aron hoi a capanaw hoi, ahni koe kaawm e a capanaw e hninaw dawk na kathek han. Hahoi teh, a hni hoi ama hoi a capanaw hoi, ahnimouh koe kaawm e a capanaw e hninaw pueng teh, thoung sak lah ao han.
Hahoi tutan e thaw, mai, ruen ka kayo e thâw, thin dawk kaawm e hmue, kuen kahni touh e hoi, aranglae loung hah na la han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hothateh, kapek e tuca doeh.
Hahoi, tangthung dawk ta e tonphuenhoehe hah BAWIPA hmalah hung e vaiyei tueng buet touh hoi satui hoi sak e vaiyei phen, vaiyei ka rapam e kahni touh na la vaiteh,
Aron e kut hoi a capanaw e kut dawk na ta pouh han. BAWIPA hmalah kahek thueng nahanelah a kahek awh han.
Hote hah ahnimae kut dawk hoi na la pouh vaiteh, BAWIPA hanlah hmuitui lah thuengnae hmaisawinae khoungroe dawk sawi han. Hothateh BAWIPA hanlah hmaisawi thuengnae doeh.
Hahoi, Aron e kapeknae lah tu takuep hah na la vaiteh, BAWIPA hmalah kahek thueng nahanlah na kahek han. Hot teh na ham lah ao han
Aron hoi a capanaw e ham lah kapek e tutan takuep hah kahek thuengnae hoi tawm thuengnae lah a phai kahek tangcoung e hoi tawm tangcoung e hah na thoung sak han.

Hothateh, Isarel catounnaw koe, Aron hoi a capanaw hanlah a yungyoe hoi kapek e lah ao han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hothateh kahek thuengnae doeh. A loung kahek tangcoung e hoi tawm tangcoung e hah na thueng sak han.
Hote hnonaw hoi a kamthoup awh teh, satui hluk teh kathounge lah ao thai awh nahan, kathounge Aron e khohna teh, a capanaw ni râw lah a coe awh han.
Hahoi, a capanaw yueng lah vaihma thaw ka tawk hane tami ni hmuen kathoung koe tawk awh hanelah, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk a kâen navah, hnin sari touh thung a khohna han.
Hahoi, kapeknae tutan hah la vaiteh, a moi hah hmuen kathoung dawk a thawng awh han.
Hottelah, Aron hoi a capanaw ni tutan moi hoi tangthung dawk e vaiyei hah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe a ca awh han.
Yonthanae, ama kapeknae hoi thoungnae dawk poe e moi hah a ca awh han. Kathounge lah ao dawkvah, alawilae taminaw ni cat thai mahoeh.
Hote kapeknae moi hoi vaiyei hah a tangtho amom totouh cawi pawiteh, hmaisawi lah ao han. Hot teh kathounge lah ao dawkvah na cat mahoeh.
Hahoi kâ na poe e naw pueng patetlah Aron hoi a capanaw lathueng vah ka sak han, hnin sari touh thung na kapek awh han.
Hnintangkuem yontha nahanlah maitotan buet touh pou na poe awh han. Hahoi yon ngaithoumnae na sak navah, khoungroe hah na thoungsak han. Thoungsak hanelah satui na awi han.
Hnin sari touh thung khoungroe hanlah yonthanae na sak vaiteh, na thoung sak han. Hat toteh, khoungroe teh kathounge lah ao vaiteh, khoungroe ka tek e pueng teh, a thoung awh han.
Hethateh, khoungroe dawk na poe hane naw doeh. Kathounge tuca kum touh e kahni touh na la vaiteh,
tuca buet touh e hah amom lah na poe vaiteh, alouke tuca buet touh e hah tangmin lah na poe han.

Tuca buet touh na poe e dawk e tavai ephah pung hra pung touh, satuium hin pung pali pung touh hoi na kalawt han ( hin teh galon buet touh doeh). Hahoi nei thueng hanelah misurtui hin pung pali pung touh na poe han.
Tuca buet touh e teh amom lah na poe vaiteh, hot teh amom vah ca hane poenae hoi nei hane poenae hmuitui, BAWIPA hanlah hmaisawi thuengnae lah na poe han.
Hot teh na ca catounnaw totouh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koevah, BAWIPA hmalah hmaisawi thuengnae pou poe hane doeh. Hote hmuen koevah, nang koe lawk deinae lahoi na kâhmo han.
Isarel catounnaw hoi hawvah kâpato vaiteh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim teh bawilennae hoi thoungsak lah ao han.
Kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hoi khoungroe kathoung sak han. Aron hoi a canaw hoi kai hanelah vaihma thaw tawk laihoi ka thaw a tawk thai awh nahan ka thoung sak han.
Hottelah Isarel catounnaw koevah, kho ka sak vaiteh, a cathut lah ka o han.
Izip ram hoi ka tâcawtkhaikung, kai teh ahnimae Cathut Jehovah lah ka o tie hah a panue awh han. Ahnimouh rahak vah kai Jehovah doeh ahnimae Cathut ka awm han.
Hahoi, hmuitui sawinae khoungroe anri thing hoi na sak han.
Ayung dong touh, adangka dong touh, a rasang dong touh hoi takin pali touh lah na sak vaiteh, a ki hateh khoungroe hoi a kâkuet han.
A lathueng lae hoi a tapang hoi a ki hah sui kathoung hoi na hluk awh vaiteh, petkâkalup lah sui hoi arai na pacawp han.
Arai pacawpnae rahim vah suilaikaw kahni touh na sak han. Avangvanglah na ta vaiteh, hothateh kâkayawtnae acung hrawt nahane doeh.
Acung teh anri thing hoi na sak vaiteh, sui tui hoi na bu sin han.
Hothateh kai ni na pato nahane hmuen lawkpanuesaknae tanae thingkong ngue nahanelah yaphni hmalah hote khoungroe hah na hruek han.
Hottelah Aron ni hawvah, hmaisawi hane hmuitui hah a sawi han. Amom karawitawi hmaiim a rakueng navah a sawi han.
Aron ni tangmin lah hmaiim paangnae tueng dawkvah, hmuitui hah hmai a sawi han. Hothateh, na ca catounnaw totouh BAWIPA hmalah hmuitui lah ao han.
Hawvah hmuitui alouke thoseh, hmaisawi thuengnae thoseh, rawca thuengnae thoseh na poe mahoeh. Hawvah, nei hane na poe e hai na awi mahoeh.

Aron ni kum touh dawk vai touh yonthanae sathei thi hah a la vaiteh, kinaw dawkvah yonthanae a sak han. Na ca catounnaw totouh kum touh dawk vai touh yonthanae a sak awh han, hot teh BAWIPA hanelah kathoungpounge doeh.   
\s1 Ratangnae tangka
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe,
Isarel catoun milu na touk toteh, milu na touk e yit touh tami pueng ni hringlu ratang nahanelah BAWIPA a poe awh han. Na touk toteh ahnimouh na touk dawkvah, ahnimouh koe lacik a pha hoeh nahanelah,
hetheh a poe awh hanelah ao. Touk tangcoung e naw pueng ni, hmuen kathoung koe hno khingnae a khing tangawn hah BAWIPA hanlah a poe awh han ( Khing touh teh gerah 20 touh doeh).
Touk tangcoung e kum 20 lathueng pueng ni, BAWIPA hanelah a poe awh han.
Na hringlu ratang nahanelah, BAWIPA hanelah na poe awh pawiteh, khing tangawn hlak kapap lah tami ka tawnta ni poe mahoeh. Hahoi ka mathoe ni hai hothlak kayoun lah poe mahoeh.

Isarel catounnaw yontha nahane tangka teh na la vaiteh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawk thawtawknae lah na pouk han. Na hringlu yontha nahane BAWIPA hmalah Isarel catounnaw hanlah Pahnim hoeh nahanlah ao nahan, telah a dei.   
\s1 Rahum kawlung
kâpasu nahanlah rahum kawlung hoi pâhung nahanlah amkhoung na sak han. Lukkareiim hoi khoungroe rahak na ta han.
Ahnimouh teh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung a kâen awh nakunghai thoseh,
BAWIPA koe hmaisawi thuengnae thueng hanelah, khoungroe koe a hnai nah thoseh,

due hoeh nahanelah, amamae kut khok hah a pâsu awh han. Hottelah ahnimouh hoi ahnimae ca catounnaw ni tarawi hane kâlawk lah ao telah ati.   
\s1 Kathounge satui hluknae
Hothloilah BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah,
hmuituinaw thung dawk a hmui katuipounge murah sekel 500 touh hoi nakzik hmuitui khing 250,
nakzik phun louk khing 500, olive satui pong 12 touh (hin buet touh) na thokhai vaiteh,
hmuitui kasakkung ni a sak e patetlah hluk e satui hah kathounge satui lah na sak han.
Kamkhuengnae lukkareiim, lawkpanuesaknae thingkong,
caboi hnopainaw, hmaiimkhok, hmuitui hmaisawinae khoungroe,
hmaisawi thuengnae khoungroe hoi hnopainaw, kawlung hoi pâhungnae amkhoung pueng hah hote hmuitui hoi koung na hluk han.
Kathoung katang e lah ao awh nahan, na thoung sak vaiteh, hote hno ka tek e pueng teh a thoung awh han.
Haw hanelah, vaihma thaw tawk laihoi, ka thaw a tawk thai awh nahanelah, Aron hoi a capanaw hah satui na awi vaiteh, na thoung sak han.
Isarel catounnaw koe, hete satui heh na ca catounnaw koe totouh kaie hluk e satui kathoung lah ao han.
Tami tak dawk na awi mahoeh. Hete sak e hoi saknae kâvan e alouke hai na sak mahoeh. Hethateh a thoung teh, nangmouh hanlah kathounge lah ao han.

Apipatethai het hoi kâvan lah a sak hai thoseh, ayâ alouk hanlah a hno hai thoseh, hote tami teh a miphun dawk hoi na takhoe han telah na dei han telah ati.   
\s1 Hmuitui
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe a hmui katuipounge hmuitui satacte hoi onycha hoi galbanum hah na la han. Hmuituipoung e ka pâcim e frankinsen hah suekâvan lah na khing vaiteh,
hmuitui kasakkungnaw patetlah palawi na phuen vaiteh, ka pâcim lah kathoungcalah na sak han.
A tangawn teh katipcalah phawm hane doeh. Kai ni na pato nahane lukkareiim thung e lawkpanuesaknae hmalah na ta han. Hothateh, nang hanelah kathounge lah ao han.
Hote hmuitui na sak hane na pâtu e patetlah sak e teh, namamouh hanelah na sak mahoeh. BAWIPA hanelah kathounge lah na pouk awh han.
Tami bangpatet nihai, phunep rumram hanelah hot patet e sak pawiteh, hote tami teh a miphun thung hoi, takhoe lah ao han telah ati.
\s1 Kutsakkathoumnaw hmounnae
Khenhaw! Judah miphun thung dawk hoi Hur capa Uri, hote capa Bezalel hah ka kaw toe.
Ahni teh lungangnae, thoumthainae, panuenae hoi bangpueng dawk kutsakthoumnae hoi,
sak hane Lungkaangcalah poukthainae hoi,
talung phu kaawm ka ta teh, bawng thainae, kâpicalah thing a thainae hoi bangpueng dawk kutsakthoumnae a tawn hanlah Cathut Muitha hoi kakawi sak toe.
Khenhaw! ahni koe thaw tawk hanlah, Ahisamak e capa Oholiab teh kai ni yo ka pouk toe. Tawk hanelah kâ ka poe e naw,
tamimaya kamkhuengnae lukkareiim, lawkpanuesaknae thingkong, avan vah lungmanae tungkhung hoi lukkareiim dawk e hnopainaw pueng,
caboi hoi hnopai, kathounge sui hoi sak e hmaiimkhok hoi a hnopainaw pueng, hmuitui sawinae khoungroe,
hmaisawi thuengnae khoungroe hoi a hnopainaw pueng, hlaam,
khohna kahawicalah pathoupnae hoi vaihma thaw a tawk nah a khohna hanelah, vaihma Aron hanlah kathounge khohna,

Kâhluk e satui hoi hmuitui kathoung hanlah hmuitui sak thai nahanlah kutsakthoumnae, lungangnae pueng ka poe. Tawk hanlah kâ ka poe e naw pueng hah a sak awh han telah a dei.   
\s1 Sabbath hoi kâkuen e kâlawk
Hahoi BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah,

Isarelnaw koevah hettelah dei pouh, kaie sabbath hah na ya awh han, bangkongtetpawiteh na ca catounnaw totouh kai hoi nangmae rahak vah mitnoutnae lah ao. Kai teh nangmouh na kathoungsakkung Jehovah lah ka o tie hah na panuethai awh nahane doeh.

Hatdawkvah, sabbath heh na ya awh han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hot teh nangmouh hanlah kathounge lah ao. Ka ek e pueng teh thei lah ao han. Hote hnin dawk Bangpatete thaw hai ka tawk e pueng teh a miphun koehoi takhoe lah ao han.
Hnin taruk touh thung thaw tawk awh naseh. A sari hnin teh kâhatnae sabbath, BAWIPA hanlah hnin kathoung doeh. Apihai sabbath hnin vah thaw tawk pawiteh, thei lah ao roeroe han.
Hatdawkvah, Isarelnaw ni sabbath teh a ca catoun totouh a yungyoe lawkkam lah awm seh.

Kai hoi Isarelnaw rahak vah, a yungyoe mitnoutnae doeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hnin taruk touh thung vah BAWIPA ni talai hoi kalvan a sak teh, asari hnin dawk a kâhat teh a thoung sak, na ti pouh han telah ati.   
\s1 Lawkpanuesaknae lungphen kahni
Hottelah Sinai mon vah koung a kâpato hnukkhu, lawkpanuesaknae lungphen kahni touh, Cathut e kutdawn hoi thut e hah Mosi koe a poe.

Mosi teh mon hoi kum laipalah ngailawi ao toe tie tamimaya ni a panue awh toteh, tamimaya teh Aron koe a kamkhueng awh teh ahni koe thaw haw, kai mouh han lah na kahrawikung cathut sak haw. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Izip ram hoi na katâcawtkhaikung Mosi e bang pawlawk hai thai hoeh toe, telah ati awh.
Aron ni, na yunaw hoi na capanaw hoi na canunaw a pacap awh e suihnapacap hah rading awh nateh kai koe thokhai awh atipouh.
Hottelah tami pueng ni suihnapacap a pacap awh lahun e hah a rading awh teh Aron koe a thokhai awh.
Aron ni ahnimouh koe e a la teh, hreca hoi a thuk teh, maitoca meikaphawk lah a hlun. Hahoi ahnimouh ni Oe Isarelnaw, hetteh Izip ram hoi na katâcawtkhaikung nangmae cathut doeh, telah ati awh.
Aron ni a hmu toteh, a hmalah khoungroe hah a sak. Aron ni, tangtho vah BAWIPA hanlah pawi awm naseh telah a oung sak.
Hottelah a tangtho vah, amom a thaw awh. Hmaisawi thuengnae a poe awh, roum thuengnae hah a poe awh teh, tamimaya teh canei hanelah a tahung awh teh lamtu hanlah a thaw awh,
BAWIPA ni Mosi a pato teh, kum leih. Bangkongtetpawiteh, na taminaw Izip ram hoi na tâcokhai e naw hah amamouh hoi amamouh koung a kâraphoe awh toe.

Kaie kâpoelawk hah tang a phen takhai awh toe. Maitoca meikaphawk a sak awh teh a bawk awh teh, hot koe thuengnae a sak awh teh, Oe Isarel hetheh Izip ram hoi na katâcawtkhaikung doeh ati awh telah ati.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe hete taminaw hah ka khet toe, a lung ka patak poung e miphun doeh.
Hatdawkvah, ahnimouh hmai koung sawi hanelah, ahnimouh lathueng ka lungkhueknae heh kaman naseh, nang heh ka lentoe e miphun lah na sak han telah ati.
Mosi ni, BAWIPA Cathut koe, BAWIPA bangkongmaw kalen e thaonae hoi thaonae kut hoi Izip ram hoi na tâcosak e na taminaw lathueng vah na lungkhueknae teh a kaman.

Bangkongmaw Izipnaw ni monsom vah patawnae poe hane hoi, thei hanelah a tâcokhai awh, telah a dei awh han. Puenghoi na lungkhueknae hah roum sak nateh, na taminaw lathueng vah, hawihoehnae sak han na noe e heh kâhno lawih.

Na san Abraham hoi Isak hoi Isarel koevah kalvan e âsinaw yit touh na catounnaw ka pung sak vaiteh, ka dei tangcoung ram heh na catoun ka poe vaiteh, a yungyoe a coe awh han, telah amahoima noe lahoi lawk na kam tangcoung e hah pahnim hanh lah a telah a kâhei.
Hot patetlah BAWIPA teh, a taminaw lathueng vah thoenae ka sak han ati nakoehoi a kâhno.
Mosi teh a kamlang teh monsom hoi a kum teh, a kut dawk lawkpanuesaknae lungphen kahni touh ao. Lungphen teh avoivang lah thut e doeh.
Lungphen teh Cathut ni sak e lah ao teh, thut e naw teh Cathut ma roeroe ni lungphen dawk thut e doeh.
Hahoi Joshua ni tamimaya pawlawk a thai toteh, Mosi koevah, roenae hmuen koe kâtuknae ao nahoehmaw telah ati.
Hatei, ahni ni tânae pawlawk nahoeh, tâ e naw e hramki lawk hai nahoeh. Hateiteh, ka thai e heh la sak pawlawk doeh ati.
Hahoi, roenae teng a pha tahma hoi maitoca meikaphawk hoi kalamtunaw hah a hmu. Hottelah Mosi lungkhueknae teh a kaman teh lungphen a sin e hah a tâkhawng teh mon khok koe a kâbawng.
A sak awh e maitoca hah a la teh, hmai a phum teh vitkatip lah a phom. Tui dawk a phuen teh Isarelnaw hah a nei sak.
Mosi ni Aron koevah, hettelah totouh yonnae kalen hah ahnimouh lathueng pha sak hanelah, hetnaw ni nang lathueng bangmaw a sak awh, telah atipouh.
Aron ni ka bawipa lungkhueknae heh kaman payon hanh naseh. Hete tamimayanaw heh hawihoehnae koe lah pou kangvawinaw doeh tie teh na panue toe.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai koevah, kaimouh na ka hrawi hanelah cathut hah na sak pouh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Mosi Izip ram hoi na kahrawikung heh a kamthang banghai thai e lah awm hoeh toe telah ati awh.
Kai ni ahnimouh koe, sui katawnnaw ni rading awh naseh, ka ti pouh teh na poe awh. Hmai dawk ka phum toteh hete maitoca meikaphawk heh a tâco telah ati.
Hahoi tamipueng khenyawn laipalah a ngai patetlah kho a sak awh tie hah a hmu teh, bangkongtetpawiteh, a tarannaw hmunae koe Aron ni khenyawn awh hoeh.
Mosi teh roenae rim longkha koe a kangdue teh, BAWIPA koelah kampang e pueng kai koe tho awh naseh, telah ati. Hattoteh Levih capanaw pueng teh ahni koe a cei awh.

Ahnimouh koe, BAWIPA Cathut ni, tami pueng ni na tahloi lat awh nateh, roenae hmuen koe kâennae longkha koehoi tâconae longkha koe totouh, na hmaunawngha thoseh, na huiko thoseh, na imri thoseh thet awh atipouh.
Hatdawkvah, Levih capanaw ni Mosi ni dei e patetlah a sak awh teh, hot hnin vah tami 3, 000 tabang a due awh.
Hattoteh Mosi ni, sahnin yawhawinae na poe awh nahanelah, na mahmawk BAWIPA hanelah kâhmoun awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, tami pueng ni a capa hoi a hmaunawngha hah a taran toe, telah ati.
Hahoi, a tangtho vah Mosi ni tamimaya koevah, yonnae kalen na sak awh toe. Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA koe ka ceitakhang han. Na yonnae yontha thai han vaimoe, telah ati.
Hottelah Mosi teh BAWIPA koe a ban teh, Oe hetnaw ni yonnae kalen a sak awh teh, sui cathut hah a sak awh.
Hatei nakunghai, a yonnae hah ngaithoum pouh haw. Hatei, na ngaithoum hoehpawiteh na cauk dawk na thut e ka min hah raphoe hanelah ka kâhei atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah, kai taranlahoi yonnae ka sak e pueng teh, ka cauk dawk hoi a min ka raphoe han.

Hatdawkvah cet nateh, ka dei e hmuen koe tamimaya hah cetkhaih. Khenhaw! kaie kalvantaminaw na hmalah a cei han. Hatei, rek hanelah ka hloe awh nah hnin vah, a yonnae dawk roeroe ka rek awh han telah ati.
Hottelah Aron ni a sak e patetlah maitoca meikaphawk a sak awh dawkvah, BAWIPA ni tamimaya teh a rek.

Hottelah BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato teh, hi hoi tâcawt awh nateh, Abraham, Isak hoi Jakop koevah, na catounnaw hanelah na poe han telah thoebo laihoi lawk ka kam e ram dawk, nang hoi Izip ram hoi na tâcokhai e naw hoi cet takhang awh.
Nangmae hmalah kalvantami ka patoun vaiteh, Kanaan taminaw, Amor taminaw, Hit taminaw, Periznaw, Hivnaw hoi Jubusitnaw hah ka pâlei han.

Khoitui hoi maitosanutui a lawngnae ram dawk cet takhang awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, kai teh nangmouh koe ka cet takhang van mahoeh. A lung ka patak poung e lah na o awh dawkvah, lamlak vah koung na pathup payon han doeh telah ati.
Hottelah tamimaya ni hete kamthang kathout a thai awh toteh, a ka awh teh apihai kamthoup ngai awh hoeh.

Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni Mosi koe Isarel catounnaw koe vah, a lung ka patak poung e miphun lah na o awh, nangmouh koe dongdeng ka o nakunghai, koung na pathup awh han. Hatdawkvah nangmouh koe ka sak hane ka panue thai nahanelah, na kamthoupnae pueng hah koung rading awh telah a dei toe.

Hatdawkvah Isarelnaw ni a kamthoupnae hah Horeb mon vah a kârading awh.   
\s1 Mosi ni BAWIPA a hmu

Mosi ni Lukkareiim hah a ceikhai teh, roenae lawilah betbet ahlanae koe ouk a yap. Hot hah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim ati awh. Hahoi BAWIPA tawng ka ngai e pueng teh, roenae lawilah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim dawkvah ouk a cei awh.
Hahoi, Mosi teh lukkareiim pâtam hoi a cei lahun nah, tamimaya a thaw awh teh amamae rim takhang koe a kangdue awh teh, Mosi lukkareiim thung a kâen totouh a khet awh.
Hahoi Mosi teh lukkareiim dawk a kâen tahma vah, tâmaikhom a kum teh lukkareiim takhang koe a kangdue teh BAWIPA ni Mosi hah a pato.
Hahoi tamimaya ni lukkareiim takhang koe tâmaikhom a kangdue e hah a hmu awh. Hat toteh, tamimaya teh a thaw awh teh, amamae rim takhang koehoi lengkaleng a bawk awh.

Tami ni a hui a pato e patetlah, BAWIPA ni Mosi hah minhmai kâhmo laihoi a pato teh, roenae hmuen koe lah a ban. A san Nun capa thoundoun Joshua hateh lukkareiim cettakhai boihoeh.   
\s1 Cathut ni okhainae lawkkam

Mosi ni BAWIPA koevah, khenhaw! nang ni kai koevah hetnaw heh luenkhai loe ati. Hatei apimaw kai koe na patoun han tie teh na panuek sak hoeh rah. Hatei, nang ni na min lahoi na panue teh, ka mit dawk minhmai kahawi ka hmu, na ti pouh.

Hatdawkvah, na mit dawk minhmai kahawi ka hmawt pawiteh, ka panue nahan hoi na mithmu vah pahrennae ka hmu thai nahanlah lamthung na panuek sak haw, telah ka kâhei. Hete miphun heh na tamimaya doeh tie hah pouk, telah ati.
Ahni ni, nangmouh koe ka o vaiteh, kâhatnae na poe awh han atipouh.
Ahni ni, kai koevah na cet hoehpawiteh, hete hmuen koehoi na tâcawt sak hanh.

Bangkongtetpawiteh, kaimouh koe na cet laipalah kai hoi na taminaw teh na mithmu vah lungmanae ka hmu awh tie hah, bangtelamaw ka panue awh han. Hottelah talai van kaawm e taminaw pueng koehoi kai hoi na taminaw teh ka pek e lah ka o awh han, atipouh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah, hot hai na dei e patetlah ka sak han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, ka mit dawk na kuep teh na min lahoi na panue telah atipouh.
Ahni ni na bawilennae teh pahren lahoi na hmawt sak haw atipouh.

Ahni ni, ka hawinae pueng heh na hmalah ka kamnue sak vaiteh, Jehovah min hah na hmalah ka pâpho han. Pahren han ka ngai e hah ka pahren vaiteh, ka lungma han ka ngai e pueng hah ka lungma han, atipouh.
Hatei ahni ni, ka minhmai teh na hmawt thai mahoeh, bangkongtetpawiteh na ka hmawt e tami hring boihoeh, ati.
BAWIPA ni khenhaw! ka teng vah hmuen buet touh ao, lungsong van na kangdue han.
Hahoi, ka bawilennae ni na ceihlawi navah, kâbawng e lungsong thungvah na ta han, na ceitakhai hoehroukrak ka kut hoi na tabuem han.
Hahoi ka kut hah bout ka la vaiteh ka hnukthun hah na hmu han, hatei, ka minhmai teh na hmawt mahoeh, atipouh.
\s1 Mosi ni lungphen a katha a sak
BAWIPA ni Mosi koevah, lungphen kahni touh a hmaloe e patetlah sak nateh hote lungphen dawkvah ahmaloe e patetlah bout ka thut han.
Tangtho vah coungkacoe lah awmh, amom Sinai mon dawk luen nateh, monsom ka hmalah kangdout.
Nang koe apihai tho awh hanh naseh. Mon vah apihai kamnuek awh nahanh seh. Tuhu hoi maitohu naw hai mon teng vah pâ awh nahanh seh ati.
Hottelah lungphen kahni touh hmaloe e patetlah a sak. Hahoi Mosi teh amom vah a thaw teh BAWIPA ni kâ a poe e patetlah lungphen kahni touh hah a sin teh, Sinai mon dawk a luen.
BAWIPA teh tâmai hoi a kum teh, a teng vah a kangdue teh BAWIPA e min hah a pathang.
BAWIPA ni a ceihlawi teh Jehovah, Jehovah, lungmanae hoi kakawi e Cathut, pahrennae, lungsawnae lungmanae hoi lawkkatang hoi akawi.

Tami a thongsang koe pahrennae kamnueksakkung, payonnae hoi lawkeknae hoi, hawihoehnae kangaithoumkung, yonpennae ka tâcawtkhai boihoeh e, napanaw payonnae dawk canaw catoun totouh, se thum se pali totouh karekkung doeh telah a pâpho.
Mosi ni karanglah talai dawk a tabo teh a bawk.

Ahni ni, Atuvah BAWIPA na mit dawk minhmai kahawi ka hmawt pawiteh, kai koevah kaie BAWIPA heh cet van naseh telah ka kâhei. A lung ka patak e miphun lah ka o awh nakunghai ka payonnae hoi ka yonnae hah na ngaithoum nateh, na râw lah na tawn lawih telah ati.   
\s1 Lawkkamnae bout a kathasak

Ahni ni, khenhaw! lawkkamnae ka sak. Talai pueng hoi miphun pueng dawk sak boihoeh e kângairu hno hah na taminaw pueng hmalah ka sak vaiteh, nangmouh kaawm e na taminaw pueng ni BAWIPA ni sak e hah a hmu awh han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmouh koe ka sak hane heh takikathopounge lah ao han.
Sahnin vah kâ na poe e naw heh pouk. Khenhaw! Amornaw, Kanaannaw, Hitnaw, Hivnaw, Periznaw hoi Jebusitnaw hah na hmalah hoi ka pâlei han.
Kâhruetcuet, hoehpawiteh na cei nahane ram dawk kaawmnaw hoi lawkkamnae na sak awh vaiteh, nangmouh hanlah karap lah awm payon vaih.
Hateiteh ahnimae khoungroe hah, koung na raphoe pouh han. Talung a ung awh e hai rekrek dei awh nateh, thing meikaphawk hah koung tâtueng pouh awh.
A min patenghai dipma Jehovah lah ao, Cathut teh a dipma thai dawkvah Cathut alouke roeroe na bawk awh mahoeh.
Hoehpawiteh hote ram dawk e taminaw hoi lawk na kam awh vaiteh, ahnimae cathut koe kâyo laihoi ahnimae cathut koe thueng laihoi buetbuet touh coun vaiteh, thuengnae moi hah ca hoi,
na capanaw hanelah ahnimae canunaw hah na paluen vaiteh, a canunaw ni a cathutnaw koe a kâyo awhnae koe, na capanaw hai kâyawt payon awh langvaih.
Thuk e meikaphawk cathut hah na sak awh mahoeh.

Tonphuenhoehe vaiyei pawi na sak han. Kâ na poe awh e patetlah, hnin sari touh thung tonphuenhoehe hah Abib thapa dawk khoe e tueng nah na ca han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Abib thapa dawkvah Izip ram hoi na tâco awh.
Camoim ka paawng e pueng kaie doeh. Na saring pueng maito hoi tu camin teh kaie doeh.
Hatei la camin teh tuca hoi na ratang han. Na ratang ngaihoeh pawiteh, a lahuen na kapai pouh han. Na capa camin teh na ratang han. Ka hmaitung vah apihai kuthrawng hoi na tâcawt awh mahoeh.
Hnin taruk touh thung thaw na tawk han. Asari hnin dawk na kâhat han. Laikawk na tawk tue nah hoi canga tue nahai na kâhat han.
Tongpa pueng kum touh dawk vai thum touh Bawipa Jehovah Isarel Cathut hmalah a tâco awh han.

Bangkongtetpawiteh, na hmalah miphunnaw ka pâlei vaiteh na ramri hah ka kaw sak han, kum touh dawk vai thum touh BAWIPA na Cathut hmalah na tâco awh nahanlah na cei toteh apinihai na ram hah noe awh mahoeh.
Kai hanelah thuengnae thipaling teh ton phuen e vaiyei hoi na poe mahoeh. Ceitakhai pawi thuengnae haiyah atangtho totouh na awm sak mahoeh.
Na law dawk e aluepaw teh BAWIPA im dawk na thokhai han. Hmaeca e moi hah a manu e sanutui hoi mek na thawng mahoeh.
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe, hete lawknaw heh thun haw, bangkongtetpawiteh, hete lawknaw tarawi lahoi nang koehoi Isarel koevah lawkkamnae ka sak, telah ati.

Hawvah BAWIPA koe hnin 40 rum 40 touh ao teh, rawca cat laipalah ao teh, tui hai net hoeh. Hahoi lungphen dawk lawkkam kâpoelawknaw hra touh a thut.   
\s1 Mosi minhmai angnae
Hahoi, Mosi teh lawkpanuesaknae lungphen kahni touh hah a kut hoi a sin teh Sinai mon hoi a kum navah, Mosi ni hottelah a kâpato dawkvah, ka minhmai vuen a ang tie hah panuek hoeh.
Aron hoi Isarelnaw pueng ni Mosi a hmu awh toteh, khenhaw! minhmai vuen a ang teh hnai ngam awh hoeh.
Mosi ni ahnimouh teh a kaw teh, Aron hoi kamkhueng e lawkcengkungnaw pueng hah ahni koe a ban awh teh Mosi ni ahnimouh teh a pato.
Isarelnaw pueng ni a hnai awh hnukkhu Sinai mon vah BAWIPA hoi lawk a kâpato roi e naw pueng patetlah ahnimanaw hah kâ a poe.
Mosi ni lawk be a dei toteh, a minhmai teh minhmai ramuknae hoi a ramuk.

Hatei ahni hoi lawk kâpato hanelah BAWIPA hmalah Mosi a luen nah tangkuem vah, bout a pato hoehroukrak a minhmai ramuknae hah ouk a hawng. Hahoi a pato teh kâ a poe e naw hah Isarelnaw koe ouk a dei pouh.
Isarelnaw ni Mosi minhmai a khet awh nah tangkuem vah, Mosi minhmai vuen teh a ang. Hahoi Mosi teh Cathut hoi kâpato hanelah a kâen hoehroukrak a minhmai ramuknae hoi a minhmai teh ouk a ramuk.
\s1 Sabbath phung
Mosi ni Isarelnaw koung a kamkhueng sak teh ahnimouh koe, BAWIPA ni tarawi hanelah kâlawk na poe e naw teh hetnaw hah doeh.
Hnin taruk touh thung thaw na tawk awh toe. Asari hnin teh nangmouh hanelah hnin kathoung doeh. BAWIPA hanelah kâhatnae sabbath hnin doeh. Hot hnin vah thaw ka tawk e tami pueng teh na thei awh han.

Sabbath hnin vah kho na sak awhnae koe hmai na patawi awh mahoeh.   
\s1 Lukkareiim khoungroe pasoumhno
Hahoi Mosi ni Isarel kamkhuengnaw pueng koevah, hetheh BAWIPA ni na poe e kâlawknaw doeh.
BAWIPA koe pasoumhno sin awh. A lungthung hoi poe han ka ngai e pueng ni BAWIPA hanelah thokhai seh. Sui, Ngun, Rahum,
kamthim hni, paling hni, âthi hni, loukloukkaang hni, hmaemuen,
paling bu e tu pho, saram pho, anri thing,
hmaiim hane satui hoi awi hane satui hoi hmaisawi hane hmuitui hoi,

ephod hoi saiphei nahanelah onyx talung hoi talungnaw sin hanelah poe awh naseh.   
\s1 Lukkareiim hnopainaw
Nangmouh thung dawk kutsak ka thoum e pueng tho awh naseh. BAWIPA ni sak hanelah kâ a poe e hah sak awh naseh.
Lukkareiim hoi lukkarei, lemphu, pangkhek, thingphek, tapang, khom hoi ung nahane pacawpnae naw hai thoseh,
thingkong hoi kâkayawtnae acung, lungmanae tungkhung, hoi rakhan nahane yaphni hai thoseh,
caboi hoi kâkayawtnae acung hoi hnopainaw pueng hoi vaiyei tanae hai thoseh,
hmaiang hanlah hmaiimkhok hoi hnopainaw hoi hmaiim hoi paang hane satui hai thoseh,
hmuitui hmaisawinae khoungroe hoi kâkayawtnae acung hoi hluk e satui hoi hmaisawi hane hmuitui hoi lukkareiim takhang koe e yap hane yaphninaw hai thoseh,
Hmaisawi thuengnae khoungroe rahum cuekkarue hoi kâkayawtnae acung hoi hnopainaw pueng, kawlung hoi pâhungnae hai thoseh,
Lukkareiim thongma yaphni, khom hoi a tapang ungnae pacawpnae naw hoi kalupnae longkha yaphninaw hai thoseh,
Lukkarei hetnae hoi thongma hetnae hoi ruinaw hai thoseh,

hmuen kathoung thaw tawknae koe, a meikahawicalah kawng e hnicu hoi vaihma thaw a tawk toteh kâkhu hane vaihma Aron hnicu kathoung hoi a capanaw hnicu hai thoseh BAWIPA ni lawk na thui e patetlah na sak awh han telah patuen a dei.   
\s1 Lukkareiim pasoumhno a poe awh
Hottelah Isarel catoun kamkhuengnaw pueng teh, Mosi koehoi a ban awh.

Lungthonae katawnnaw hoi muitha lahoi pasoungnae ka tawn e pueng a tho awh teh, kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hanelah hno hane hoi thaw tawk nahanelah a panki e pueng, kathounge hnicu hanelah BAWIPA hanelah lengkaleng a poe awh.

Napui hoi tongpa hoi poe ngainae lung ka tawn e pueng a tho awh teh, laikaw, hnâpacap, kuthrawt, hnawngpacap, sui hoi sak e hnopai pueng hah a sin awh. Sui poe hane ka tawn e pueng ni BAWIPA hanelah a poe awh.
Tami pueng ni, kamthim hni, âthi hni, paling hni, loukloukkaang hni, hmaemuen hoi tutan pho paling bu e hoi saram pho ka tawn e pueng ni a thokhai awh.
Hahoi tangka hoi rahum ka thokhai e tami pueng ni, BAWIPA hanelah poe hane hah a thokhai awh. Tami pueng ni anri thing, hnopai hanelah hno kamcu e hah a thokhai awh.
Kutsakkathoume napui pueng ni, pahla a san awh teh, a pakhit awh e pahla, kamthim, âthi hni, paling hni, Loukloukkaang e hah a thokhai awh.
Kutsakkathoume napui a lung a kathonaw ni hmaemuen hah a kawng awh.
Vaihma angki hoi angki akalae patawp hanelah ukkungnaw ni onyx talung hoi talung phu kaawmnaw hah a thokhai awh.
Hmuitui hoi satui hoi, paang hane hoi hluk hane satui hoi hmuitui hmaisawi hane thoseh,

Isarel catounnaw ni BAWIPA hanelah ngainae hoi poe e hno hah a poe awh teh, napui hoi tongpa lungthonae ka tawn e pueng ni sak hanelah BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâ a poe e patetlah tawk nahanelah hnopainaw thoseh a poe awh.   
\s1 Cathut ni kaw e kutsakkathoumnaw
Mosi ni Isarel catounnaw koevah, Khenhaw! BAWIPA ni Judah miphun thung hoi Hur capa Uri, a capa Bezalel hah
lungangnae hoi thaipanueknae, panuenae hoi bangpueng koe kutsak thoumnae tawn hanelah Cathut Muitha hoi akawi sak toe.
Sak hane lungangcalah poukthainae, sui, ngun, rahum dêi thainae,
talung phu kaawm pâthit hanelah bawng thainae, meikahawicalah thing a thainae, bangpueng dawk kutsak thoumnae tawn hanelah a kaw toe.
Hahoi ama hoi Dan miphun thung e Ahisamak capa Oholiab hoi ayâ cangkhai thainae hah a lungthung vah a ta pouh toe.

Ahni teh bangpueng dawk kutsak thoumnae, ca thut thainae, mei thuk thainae, imthung pathoup thainae, kamthim, paling, âthi, Loukloukkaangnaw carouk thainae, hnikawngthainae, phunkuep tawk thainae, hoi tawk hane kahawicalah poukthainae tawn hanelah lungangnae hoi akawi sak toe.

Bezalel hoi Oholiab tinaw ni kutsakkathoumnaw pueng BAWIPA ni kâ a poe e patetlah, hmuen kathoung dawk thaw a tawk thai awh nahanelah, thaw phunkuep a tawk thai awh nahanelah lungangnae hoi thaipanueknae a poe e naw pueng ni lengkaleng tawk hane doeh, telah ati.   
\s1 Tamimaya ni panki e hloilah a poe awh
Mosi ni Bezalel hoi Oholiab tinaw kutsakkathoume, BAWIPA ni ahnimae lungthin dawk lungangnae a poe teh a thaw tawk hanelah a lungthin dawk lungthonae a poe e naw pueng hah a kaw.
Isarel catounnaw ni hmuen kathoung thawtawknae koe a tâcokhai awh e pueng hah Mosi koehoi a coe awh. Hahoi amom tangkuem ngainae lahoi poe e hah ahni koe pou a poe awh.
Kutsakkathoumnaw pueng, hmuen kathoung thaw katawknaw pueng ni thaw a tawk awh lahun e hah lengkaleng a ceitakhai awh teh,
Mosi koevah, BAWIPA ni tawk han kâ a poe e thaw tawk hanelah taminaw ni acawilah hno a sin awh, telah a pathang awh.

Mosi ni kâ a poe teh, hmuen kathoung hanelah poehno hah napui hai tongpa hai apihai poe hanelah kâcai awh nahanh lawiseh, telah roenae hmuen koe a oung sak. Hottelah taminaw ni a poe awh e hah pasoung hoeh toe.

Bangkongtetpawiteh, a tawn awh tangcoung e hah panki e pueng sak nahanelah a khout toe. Atangcalah apap poung toe.   
\s1 Lukkareiim saknae

Ahnimouh thung dawk a lungkaangnaw pueng ni, lukkareiim teh yaphni hra touh hoi a sak awh. Hote yaphni teh Loukloukkaang e hoi carouk e kamthim, paling, âthi naw hoi kathoumnaw ni cherubim mei a sak awh e hah kamnuek lah sak e lah ao.
Yaphni teh dong 28 touh lengkaleng a saw teh, akaw e teh dong pali touh rip a pha. Yaphni pueng ayung adangka koung a kâvan.
Yaphni panga touh a kâbet teh, alouke panga touh hai koung a kâbet.
Patawp e yaphni rui a poutnae koe vah, laikaw kamthim lah sak e lah ao. Hot patetlah patawp e yaphni avanglae a poutnae koe haiyah sak e lah ao.
Yaphni buet touh dawk laikaw 50 touh a sak teh alouke patawp e dawk haiyah, laikaw 50 touh a sak. Hote laikawnaw teh minhmai kâhmo lah ao awh.
Hahoi sui hetnae 50 touh a sak teh, hetnae naw ni yaphni hah a hetsin. Hottelah lukkareiim teh rakhan buet touh lah a coung.
Hahoi lukkareiim lemphu ramuknae lah, Hmae muen yaphni hah hlaibun touh a sak.
Yaphni teh dong 30 touh saw sak lah ao teh, akaw e teh dong pali touh lengkaleng a pha. Yaphni hlaibun touh teh koung a kâvan.
Yaphni panga touh hah patawp e lah ao teh, yaphni taruk touh hai patawp e lah ao.
Patawp e yaphni buet touh a rai poutnae koe vah laikaw 50 touh a sak teh, yaphni patawp e avanglae arai dawk hai laikaw 50 touh a sak.
Lukkareiim hah rakhan buet touh lah ao nahanelah, hetsin nahanelah hetsinnae 50 touh hah rahum hoi a sak.
Hahoi tutan pho paling bu e hoi lukkareiim lemphu ramuknae hoi hot van ramuk nahanelah saram pho hoi a sak.
Lukkareiim tapang thung hanelah anri thing hoi a sak.
Thingphek teh dong hra touh asaw teh, dong touh hoi tangawn akaw.
Thingphek tangkuem dawk a khok kahni touh hoi a kâkuetsak. Hottelah lukkareiim tapang pueng teh a sak.
Lukkareiim hanelah tapang thingphek hah a sak teh, akalae tapang hanelah thingphek 20 touh a sak.
Hote thingphek 20 touh a kangdue nahanelah ngun pacawp 40 touh a sak. Thingphek buet touh dawk a khok kahni touh pâhung nahanelah pacawp kahni touh rip a sak.
Lukkareiim atunglae hanlah thingphek 20 touh hoi
ngun pacawp 40, thingphek buet touh hanelah pacawp kahni touh rip a sak.
Lukkareiim kanîloumlah hane thingphek 6 touh a sak.
Lukkareiim hnuk lae takin koe hanelah thingphek kahni touh hai a sak.
A rahim hoi a lathueng lae laikaw totouh a kâkuetsak. A takin roi koe hot patetlah a sak.
Thingphek taroe touh, pâhung nahane ngun pacawp 16 touh hoi ao. Thingphek buet touh pâhung nahanelah pacawp kahni touh rip ao.
Hahoi lukkareiim tapang pangkhek hanelah anri thing panga touh,
lukkareiim avanglah hane panga touh a sak.
A lungui e tarennae hah avoivang lae takin koe rek a pâcue sak.
Thingpheknaw hah sui hoi a hluk. Tarennae hrawt nahanelah sui laikaw hai a sak teh, tarennae naw hah sui hoi a hluk.
Yaphni hanelah kamthim, âthi, paling, loukloukkaang e hni hoi cherubim meikahawicalah a sak.
Hot hanelah anri thing khom pali touh a sak teh sui tui hoi a hluk. Hahoi a bangnae naw teh sui hoi sak e doeh. Hotnaw pâhung nahanelah ngun pacawp pali touh a hlun.
Hahoi lukkareiim takhang koe yap hanelah, kamthim, âthi, paling, Loukloukkaang e hoi carouk e kathoumnaw ni kahawicalah carouk e hoi a sak.

Hotnaw yap nahanelah khom panga touh, bang nahane naw hoi a sak. Hote khom a som kacoumnaw hoi yapnae khomnaw teh, sui tui hoi hluk e lah ao. Hotnaw pâhung nahanelah pacawp e panga touh hateh rahum hoi sak e doeh.
Bezalel ni anri thing e thingkong hah ayung dong hni tangawn, adangka dong touh hoi tangawn, arasang dong touh hoi tangawn hoi a sak.
A thung hoi alawilah sui tui kathoung hoi hluk e lah ao teh, sui hoi a rai yep e lah ao.
A khok pali touh pâhung nahanelah, sui laikaw pali touh a hlun. Laikaw kahni touh e teh avanglah hane a tho teh, alouke kahni touh e teh avanglah hane a tho.
Hahoi anri thing hoi kâkayawtnae acung hah a sak teh, sui tui hoi a hluk.
Thingkong hah kâkayawt thai nahanelah a tapang dawk e laikaw dawk a hrawt.
Sui kathoung hoi lungmanae tungkhung hah a sak teh, ayung dong hni touh hoi tangawn, adangka dong touh hoi tangawn.
Hahoi cherubim kahni touh hah sui hoi a sak. Lungmanae tungkhung som dawk e roi teh dei lah a dei.
Avang lae apoutnae koe cherubim buet touh, avanglae apoutnae koe cherubim buet touh, lungmanae tungkhung hoi kâbet sak hanelah avoivang lah apoutnae koe vah cherubim hah a ta.

Cherubim hah minhmai kâhmo lah, lungmanae tungkhung hah a rathei a kadai teh a khu teh, lungmanae tungkhung koe lah a kangvawi.   
\s1 Caboi
Hahoi anri thing hoi caboi hah a sak teh, ayung dong hni touh, adangka dong touh, arasang dong touh hoi tangawn.
Hot teh suitui kathoung hoi hluk lah ao teh sui hoi a tâphai hah a pacawp.
Kuttabei hlawk touh a tâphai a sak teh, sui hoi a pacawp.
Hot hanelah sui laikaw pali touh a hlun teh, hote laikaw pali touh hah caboi khok pali touh dawk a bet.
Caboi teh kâkayawt thai nahanelah laikaw teh a tâphai teng vah a bang.
Caboi teh kâkayawt thai nahanelah acung hah anri thing hoi a sak teh sui tui hoi a hluk.

Caboi van vah hno hane tongben, pacen, awi nahane manangkhom hah sui kathoung hoi a sak.   
\s1 Hmaikhom
Hahoi hmaiimkhok teh suikathoung hoi a sak. Hmaiimkhok teh dêi lah a dêi. A kutnaw, manangnaw, a peinaw teh koung kâkuen lah a dêi.
Hmaiimkhok avoivang lah a kang kathum touh reira a tâco teh, a kut taruk touh ao.
Hmaiimkhok dawk hoi e a kang kathum touh dawk e a kang buet buet touh dawkvah, a peimuem, hoi almond paw hoi mei kâvan e manang kathum touh ao.
Hmaiimkhok dawkvah a peimuem hoi almond paw hoi mei kâvan e manang pali touh ao.
Hmaiimkhok dawk a kut taruk touh ao e patetlah avoivang lae a kut kahni touh e rahim vah a peimuem buetbuet touh rip ao.
A peimuem hoi a kutnaw hah buet touh lah koung a kâkuetsak teh abuemlahoi suikathoung hoi dei e doeh.
Hmaiim sari touh hoi, paitei, paitei tanae naw pueng hai suikathoung hoi a sak.

Hmaiim hoi hmaiim hnopai pueng hah suikathoung talen buet touh hoi a sak.   
\s1 Hmuitui sawinae khoungroe
Hahoi hmuitui sawi nahanelah anri thing hoi khoungroe hah a sak. Ayung dong touh, adangka dong touh. Takin pali touh ao. Arasang dong hni touh. A kinaw hoi koung a kâkuet.
A lathueng lae a tapang hoi a kinaw teh, suikathoung tui hoi hluk lah ao teh suikathoung hoi a tâphai hah a pacawp.
A tâphai a rahim lae a rai reira dawk sui laikaw kahni touh a sak teh, a hmo a voivang lah kahni reira koe sak lah ao. Hot hah teh kâkayawtnae acung hrawt nahane doeh.

Hahoi anri thing hoi kâkayawtnae a sak teh suitui hoi hluk e lah ao.   
\s1 Hluk e satui hoi hmuitui
Hahoi kathounge satui hluk e, kathounge hmuitui sawi hanelah hmuitui ka sak thai e patetlah a sak.
\s1 Hmaisawi thuengnae khoungroe saknae
Hahoi anri thing hoi hmaisawi thuengnae khoungroe hah a sak. Ayung dong panga touh, adangka dong panga touh, takin pali touh ao. Arasang dong thum touh.
Takin pali touh som vah kinaw hah a sak. Hote kinaw teh khoungroe hoi koung a kâkuet teh, rahum tui hoi hluk e lah ao.
Khoungroe hanelah hno e hnopainaw pueng, hlaam, ampaikei, kawlung, cingco, hmaisaan lanae hah a sak. Hote hnonaw pueng teh rahum hoi sak e seng doeh.
Hahoi khoungroe hanelah rahum cuekkarue hah a sak teh khoungroe keng koe rahim vah a ta.
Kâkayawtnae acung hrawtnae cuekkarue takin pali touh koe bang hanelah rahum laikaw pali touh a hlun.
Kâkayawtnae acung hah anri thing hoi a sak teh, rahum tui hoi a hluk.

Kâkayawt nahane khoungroe rai e laikaw dawkvah, acung hah a hrawt. Khoungroe teh a lûlahei pou a aw thai nahanlah thingphek hoi a sak.   
\s1 Rahum kawlung

Hahoi rahum kawlung hoi pâhungnae a khok hah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang koe thaw ka tawk awh e napuinaw e hlalang hoi a sak.   
\s1 Lukkareiim kalupnae
Hahoi lukkareiim thongma hah a sak teh, akalae yaphni teh loukloukkaang e hoi dong 100 touh hoi a sak.
Hote yaphni hanelah khom 20 touh, rahum khomkhok pacawp 20 touh a sak teh, khom hetnae, pangkheknaw teh ngun hoi a sak.
Atunglae yaphni teh dong 100 touh a pha. Khom 20 touh, rahum khomkhok pacawp 20 touh a sak teh, khom hetnae, pangkheknaw teh ngun hoi a sak.
Kanîloumlae yaphni teh dong 50 touh a pha. Khom hra touh, pacawpnae hra touh. Khom hetnae, pangkheknaw teh ngun hoi a sak.
Longkha avoivang lae yaphni teh dong hlaipanga touh a pha.
Khom kathum touh, pacawpnae kathum touh.
Kalupnae yaphni pueng teh loukloukkaang e hoi sak e seng doeh.
Hahoi khom pacawpnae, hetnae, pangkheknaw teh rahum hoi sak e doeh.
Hahoi kalupnae longkha koe e yaphni teh, kamthim, âthi, paling, loukloukkaang e hoi carouk e ayung dong 20, rasang dong panga touh a pha. Kalupnae yaphni hoi rei a kâvan.
Kalupnae takhang khom teh pali touh, rahum khok pacawpnae pali touh, hetnae ngun, pangkhek ngun, ngun hoi sak e khom ramuknae naw ao.

Hahoi Lukkareiim petkâkalup lah hetnae pueng teh rahum hoi sak e lah ao.   
\s1 Alouke hnopainaw
Hetheh lukkareiim hnopai, lawkpanuesaknae lukkareiim hanelah hno e, Mosi ni kâpoe e patetlah Aron capa Ithamar hoi Levih miphunnaw ni a touk awh e doeh.

Ahni koe Dan miphun Ahisamak capa Oholiab ca thut kathoum, kutsak kathoum, kamthim, âthi, paling, loukloukkaang meikahawicalah ka carouk thai e ni hai a tawk.
Hmuen kathoung a pankinae pueng koe hno hane suinaw pueng, a poe awh e teh hmuen kathoung thung khingnae patetlah pong 2, 195 touh a pha.
Touk tangcoung e tamimaya koe kabawknaw ni a poe awh e ngun hmuen kathoung koe khingnae patetlah pong 7, 550 touh a pha.
Kum 20 lathueng touk tangcoung e tamimaya koe kacetnaw teh 603, 550 touh a pha teh, hmuen kathoung koe khingnae patetlah a poe awh e teh khing tangawn lengkaleng a pha.

Hahoi ngun thung hoi pong 7, 500 touh teh hmuen kathoung khomnaw pacawp hane hoi ung nahanelah a hno awh. Pacawpnae hah 100 touh a pha teh, pacawpnae buet touh ramuk nahanelah hno e teh pong 75 touh a pha.
Ka cawi e ngun pong 50 touh hoi khom dawk bangnae hah a sak teh, khom ramuknae teh ngun tui hoi hluk e lah ao. Hahoi yapnae pangkhek hah a sak.
A poe awh e rahum talen 70 touh hoi shekel 2,400 touh a pha.
Hot teh kamkhuengnae takhang khom pâhungnae khom pacawp hoi rahum khoungroe hoi rahum cuekkarue hoi,
lukkareiim kamkhuengnae thongma petkâkalup lah khom pâhungnae khom pacawp hoi lukkareiim hetnae pueng lah koung a hno awh.

Hahoi kamthim, âthi, paling naw hoi hmuen kathoung thaw tawk nahanelah a meikahawicalah khohna hah a sak teh, BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâ a poe e patetlah Aron hanelah kathounge khohna hah a sak.   
\s1 Angkidung
Sui, kamthim, âthi, paling loukloukkaang e hoi carouk e vaihma angki hah a sak.
Sui hah ka rapamcalah a dêi teh ayung lahoi a bawng teh, kamthim, âthi, paling, loukloukkaang e kutsakkathoume ni a carouk teh a sak.
Kâyeng e 20 touh lah a sak teh, angki a lathueng lae a rai roi a kâkuet nahanelah rui hoi a sui sin.
Angki van kâyeng hane taisawm meikahawicalah kawng e hah angki hoi kâvan e lah ao teh, BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâ a poe e patetlah sui hoi kamthim, âthi, paling, loukloukkaang e carouk e hoi kawng e doeh.
Karnelian talung kahni touh a kata awh teh, sui tabu thung a bet awh. Kuthrawt dawk min thuk e patetlah Isarel miphunnaw e minnaw hah a thut.

BAWIPA ni Mosi koe lawk a thui e patetlah Isarel miphunnaw pahnim hoeh nahanelah, hote talung kahni touh hah vaihma angki kâyengnae dawk a bet awh.   
\s1 Lungtabue ramuk
Saiphei hah vaihma angki sak e patetlah sui, kamthim, âthi, paling, loukloukkaang e carouk e hoi a sak.
Bawkhni touh lah thep e lah ao teh, takin pali touh lah a o, ayung khap touh, adangka khap touh, takin pali touh hoi rei a kâvan.
Saiphei dawk talung 40 touh lah a pâthit. Apasueke rui dawk Sardius, topaz, emerald doeh.
Apâhni e rui dawk emerald, sapphire hoi diamon doeh.
Apâthum e rui dawk Jacinth, agate hoi amethyst doeh.
Apali e rui dawk beril, onyx, hoi jasper doeh. Hotnaw teh sui tabu dawk a pâthit awh.
Isarelnaw miphun hlaikahni touh e hah noutnae min thut e patetlah, hote talungnaw dawkvah, hote hlaikahni touh e minnaw hah a thut teh, talung buet touh dawk min buet buet touh rip ao.
Hahoi saiphei van vah, tangron patetlae dingyin sui kathoung hoi a sak.
Sui pahla vei e kahni touh hoi sui laikaw kahni touh a sak teh, saiphei dawk laikaw kahni touh hah a bang.
Hahoi suibawtarui vei e kahni touh hah saiphei a tâphai lae rui dawk e laikaw dawkvah a sui.
A meikahawicalah vei e dingyin kahni touh avanglae asomnaw teh, sui pahla vei e kahni touh dawkvah, a patawp awh teh, vaihma angki a hma lae kâyengnae dawk a sui.
Sui laikaw kahni touh a sak teh, ephod rahim lah kaawm e saiphei rahim lae taki kahni touh dawk a bang.
Alouke sui laikaw kahni touh hai a sak teh, vaihma angki a hma lae rahimca hoi kâyengnae lathueng patawpnae koe angki hah avangvanglah a bet.

Saiphei sui laikaw kahni touh hah vaihma angki, sui laikaw kahni touh hoi mek sui teh, kamthim e pahlarui hoi a sak. Hottelah BAWIPA ni Mosi koe lawk a thui e patetlah saiphei teh kâyengnae dawkvah bang lah ao teh, vaihma angki hoi reirei pou ao.   
\s1 Vaihma hnicu
Hahoi vaihma angkidung teh kamthim hoi dueng kawng e hoi a sak.
Angkidung lungui vah angki kutkaduem patetlah a aw sak. Ka aw e teh a kâphi hoeh nahanelah, a rai hah pou a yep.
Angkidung dawkvah, tale paw mei hah kamthim, âthi, paling, loukloukkaang e carouk e hoi a sak.
Hahoi sui kathoung hoi dinghlingnaw hah a sak teh, angki pawi dawk e talepaw rahak vah cakhout laihoi a bang.
BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe e patetlah dinghling buet touh hoi tale paw buet touh rip hah angki pawi petkâkalup lah thaw tawk nahanelah kamthoupnae dawk a ta.
Hahoi Aron hoi a capanaw hanelah loukloukkaang e hoi kawng e hah a sak.
Loukloukkaang e hoi sak e vaihma lupawk hoi luhuem, loukloukkaang e hoi sak e hnadung hoi,
loukloukkaang e carouk e hoi kamthim, âthi, paling hoi meikahawicalah em la e hoi kathoumnaw ni em la e taisawm hoi BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâ a poe e patetlah a sak.
Hahoi bawilakhung hanelah sui phen hah sui kathoung hoi a sak, BAWIPA KOE THOUNGNAE telah thut e hah a kamnue sak.

Hahoi BAWIPA ni Mosi koe kâ a poe e patetlah vaihma lupawk a patunglah bet hanelah kamthim e rui hoi a sui.

caboi hoi hnopainaw pueng hoi vaiyei tanae hai thoseh,
suikathoung hoi sak e hmaiimkhok hoi hmaiim hoi, hnopai pueng hoi paang nahane satui hoi thoseh,

Lawkpanuesaknae hah a la teh, thingkong thung vah a hruek. Thingkong dawk acung hah a hrawt teh, Thingkong van lungmanae tungkhung hah a hruek.
BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe tangcoung e patetlah thingkong teh lukkareiim thung vah a hruek. Rakhannae yaphni hah a yap teh, lawkpanuesaknae thingkong teh rakhan thung vah ao.
Caboi teh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung, atunglah yaphni lawilah a hruek.
BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe tangcoung e patetlah BAWIPA hmalah caboi dawk vaiyei teh a pâhung.
Hmaiimkhok hah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung akalah, caboi hoi kadangka lah a hruek.
BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe tangcoung patetlah hmaiim hah BAWIPA hmalah a hruek.
BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe tangcoung patetlah sui khoungroe teh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung yaphni hmalah a hruek teh,
Hahoi lukkareiim takhang yaphni hah a yap.
BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe tangcoung patetlah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim takhang kung koevah, hmaisawi thuengnae khoungroe hah a hruek teh, hot van vah hmaisawi thuengnae hoi canei thuengnae hah a thueng.
BAWIPA ni Mosi kâ a poe tangcoung patetlah kawlung hah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim hoi khoungroe rahak vah a hruek teh, kâpasu nahanlah tui a hlun.
Mosi, Aron hoi a capanaw ni haw vah a kutnaw hoi a khoknaw hah a pâsu awh.
Kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung a kâen han nah hoi, khoungroe teng a cei awh han nah ouk a pâsu awh.

Hahoi lukkareiim hoi khoungroe petkâkalup lah a kalup teh, thongma e longkha dawk yaphni hah a yap teh, hottelah Mosi ni thaw hateh a cum.   
\s1 Tâmai hoi bawilennae
Hottelah kamkhuengnae lukkareiim teh tâmai ni muen a kayo teh, lukkareiim teh BAWIPA bawilennae hoi a kawi.
Hot patetlah tâmai a pâyam teh, BAWIPA bawilennae hoi lukkareiim muen akawi dawkvah, Mosi teh kamkhuengnae lukkareiim thung kâen thai hoeh.
Tâmai ni lukkareiim a kâtawm takhai torei vah, Isarelnaw teh a cei awh nahane koe lah ouk a cei awh.
Hatei, tâmai ni kâtawm takhai hoehpawiteh, a kâtawm hoehroukrak kampuen laipalah ao awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kahlawng a cei awh nah thung pueng, Isarelnaw pueng e mithmu vah, BAWIPA e tâmai teh kanîthun vah lukkareiim lathueng a pâyam teh, karum vah ahnimouh lathueng ouk a ang pouh.
